{{Top}}
'''Ossic architecture''' was an architectural form that was native to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. The aesthetic utilized the bones of very large vertebrate creatures such as [[Ruhau-whale/Legends|ruhau-whales]] to create housing and structures in the sinkhole cities; [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] in particular was filled with such structures.
